title: THE 2-PLAYER PARTY LINES BECOME SHORT CALLOUTS
why: His rule (RULES: never an explaining sentence on screen; answer 27 lets us reword): the 2-player hub toasts and PARTY window lines were full sentences with a full stop, such as pillager joined your party
now: They read as short callouts with no full stop: pillager joined, waiting for player 2, party ascended, out until the next raid.
